title: Stationary Crossover Series
description: A stationary ball-handling series — low crossovers, between-the-legs and behind-the-back — to build control before adding movement.

content.objective: Build a low, controlled crossover dribble without needing to travel anywhere.
content.setup: Each player has a ball and stands in a wide athletic stance.
instructions: Crossover the ball low from hand to hand for 20 touches.
Add a between-the-legs crossover for 20 touches.
Add a behind-the-back crossover for 20 touches.
Mix all three randomly for a final 30 seconds.
coachingPoints: Keep the dribble below the knee on every crossover.
Use the fingertips to push the ball, not a slap.
Keep the head up and eyes forward throughout.
commonMistakes: Letting the dribble rise above waist height.
Watching the ball instead of an imaginary defender.
Watching the ball instead of keeping the head up.
content.safety: Leave enough space between players so a stray ball doesn't roll into a neighbour.
progressions: Add a defender waving a hand to add distraction without contact.
